task: Build prospective time-resolved Starbreaker source dynamics and carrier-to-wave bridge
objective: Lift the frozen three-state Starbreaker trajectory surface into a zero-fit continuous spherical flow, retest the source-native escape-before-closure inequality, and construct the first dimensionless trace-free carrier quadrupole source coupled to the sealed 3/8 real and 4/45 damping QNM kernel.
source_use: CR005, CR005b, CR005c, and the frozen Starbreaker roster are constructive inputs. No predecessor verdict is audited or overwritten.

continuous_flow.clock: dimensionless Starbreaker structural phase t in [0,2]
continuous_flow.collapse_phase: For t in [0,1], r(t)=r0*exp(t*ln(rc/r0)) with fixed spherical angles; the zero-radius limit is handled continuously.
continuous_flow.bounce_event: t=1 is an explicit velocity-changing bounce impulse, not a resolved microphysical shock thickness.
continuous_flow.release_phase: For s=t-1 in [0,1], r(s)=rc+s*(r1-rc), theta(s)=thetac+s*(theta1-thetac), and phi(s)=phic+s*wrap(phi1-phic) on the shortest azimuthal branch.
continuous_flow.endpoint_rule: The flow must reproduce seed, collapse, and final source coordinates to absolute error <= 1e-12.

timing_surface.tau_escape: earliest outward continuous-flow crossing among post-collapse 010/110 carrier-matter relations
timing_surface.tau_closure: earliest inward continuous-flow crossing among 101 carrier-matter relations
timing_surface.root_rule: Earliest direction-compatible bracket on a frozen 32-bin scan followed by 40 bisection steps.
timing_surface.root_control: A deterministic prefix of up to 256 transitions per scenario is repeated with 64 scan bins; max absolute root difference must be <= 1e-9.

timing_evidence_ladder.strong: All six geometry-by-door cells have more than 50 percent of dual carriers with tau_escape < tau_closure and positive median closure-minus-escape margin.
timing_evidence_ladder.directional: Overall fraction exceeds 50 percent, both geometry medians are positive, and at least four of six geometry-by-door cells exceed 50 percent.
timing_evidence_ladder.boundary: The continuous source flow is constructed but the ordering is not stable enough for promotion.

carrier_source_tensor.carrier_weight: one unit per typed carrier occurrence; no matter-mass or energy calibration
carrier_source_tensor.coherence_gain: P_Q divided by the sum of the individual-carrier P_Q values; the denominator is the exact Rademacher-sign incoherent expectation.

populations.all_carriers: all typed carriers in one scenario
populations.escape_only: at least one 010/110 release and no 101 return
populations.return_only: at least one 101 return and no 010/110 release
populations.dual: both post-collapse ending-zero release and 101 return

carrier_source_tensor.grid: primary 2L=324 equal post-bounce intervals; convergence control L=162 intervals
carrier_source_tensor.qnm_output: dimensionless unit-clock response candidate from discrete causal convolution of S_ab with g

wave_source_ladder.strong: The source construction and convergence gates pass; escape_only median coherence_gain exceeds 1 in both geometries and at least four of six geometry-by-door cells; escape_only median per-carrier power exceeds return_only in at least four cells with both populations.
wave_source_ladder.constructed: The trace-free source and QNM response are finite, nonzero, converged, and population-separated, but the strong directional separation gates do not all pass.
wave_source_ladder.fail: A source identity, trace-free, convergence, finite-value, zero-input, or sealed-QNM-coefficient gate fails.

controls: all frozen source hashes match before and after execution
all three stored states are reproduced by the continuous flow
continuous roots have the requested direction and pass the 64-bin prefix convergence control
rigid rotation and global translation preserve timing on a deterministic prefix
radial-only release is not numerically identical to the spherical-flow release when source azimuth changes
Q is trace free to numerical tolerance
coarse/fine all-carrier power and response medians agree within 5 percent
zero source yields zero QNM response and an analytic impulse yields the sealed kernel
omega_R=3/8 and omega_I=4/45 are read exactly from sealed CR005/CR005b artifacts
no seconds, strain, luminosity, distance, detector observable, signal speed, fitted parameter, or SAM registry mutation

may_establish: a prospective zero-fit continuous kinematic Starbreaker flow in structural phase time
whether escape-before-closure survives curved continuous trajectories
a dimensionless trace-free carrier quadrupole source surface
a conditional unit-clock response using the sealed 3/8 and 4/45 QNM kernel
whether ending-zero-only and returned-only carrier populations separate on source power and coherence
may_not_establish: physical time in seconds or a derived time-to-matter-creation law
a relativistic stress-energy tensor, Einstein-equation solution, event horizon, or causal speed
physical gravitational-wave strain, luminosity, spectrum, or detector forecast
that carriers are gravitons or that X1 has been physically identified
a universal law independent of the frozen Starbreaker source model
